text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
400 meters to go!
The Umamusume charge right past the roaring fans!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Here it comes, here it comes, here it comes!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Right O-o-o-oh! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Downhill slope, ride this momentum and let those legs fly!
Don't muscle it, just increase the cadence!!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(...ROOOAAAR!! ...)
(...RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, breathing's getting in the way!
Every breath slows my legs! If I just hold my breath—)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Ghhhhhhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Calstone Light O has broken awayyy!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —...UWWAAAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O takes 1st!!
Just look at that! The winning time is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the same tempo as the footsteps that raced by,
—a heartbeat resonated throughout my entire body.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Fufufu! Ufufufu!
Ah, my heart is dancing!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
The history of the Umamusume rooted within me...
is awakening and murmuring.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Would you call this... blood boiling?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I feel... the same way.
Yeah. I feel... the same way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An impact that shook all five senses.
Footsteps pounding the earth, the trembling grandstand, the scent of the turf,
the wind cutting against the cheeks, the lingering trails of light in vision...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A flash of light grazing past my eyes for just an instant.
Experiencing a speed beyond what human flesh can grasp, awe surges alongside overwhelming delight.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... amazing. Wait, that was so awesome...!
What was that?! What was that?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Are Umamusume really that fast!?
It was over in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was seriously fast! Is it 'cause it was a straight track?
Wasn't she running at top speed the whole time!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I mean... just how fast can Umamusume get?
Could there be a chance... we can get even faster than today?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Top speed!! The fastest I can possibly run right now!
I did it... I really did it!!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, time! What was my time!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that? A personal best!
I beat my top speed, didn't I!?
choice_data_list: Yeah. You just beat your top instantaneous speed record!
Yeah. Peak top speed—you've set a new record!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I……! I did itttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I was confident!
Because I felt that today was my personal best run yet! After all—
choice_data_list: W-Wait... Just calm down for a second!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask!? I just broke my top speed record!
There's no way I can stay calm!
People are always saying I'm restless anyway!
choice_data_list: The official times will be announced shortly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What I told you was just the hand-timed split. The officially recognized time will be announced once the results are finalized. That will be the top speed that goes down in the record books.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, true, there is no meaning unless it is officially certified...
I shall wait.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
And now, to our first-place winner, Calstone Light O-san.
How does it feel to have conquered
the Ibis Summer Dash?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy! I'm walking on air, to the point where I want to hug everyone here!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, I will become even faster!
Faster than ever! I will keep breaking my own top speed!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If I get too fast and you can't see me anymore,
I'm sorry! That is all!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Fine by me, vanish all you want!
I can't wait to see an even faster Wright O!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Keep getting faster and faster, with no limit!
We want to see running like that too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Faster!’—The very words Calstone Light O
always uttered could now be heard
echoing all throughout the stands."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —You as well, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: So you desire it, then—a run at maximum speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's been a while since I've felt this way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm on cloud nine as well, Calstone Light O.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, something strange is happening.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If I am to reach an even greater top speed,
I want to achieve it in front of everyone.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The competition necessary to reach top speed. Opponents to rival against.
I think I understand what Trainer meant now.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, the audience does not affect my running.
No matter who is watching or not. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explain that both the cheering of fans and the racetrack's atmosphere
can become a source of strength for an Uma Musume,
or conversely, sap away their energy.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Throughout the long history of racing,
Umamusume have continuously been surrounded
by the cheers and love of their fans.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Perhaps the desire to share our joy is due to memories etched deep into an Umamusume's blood.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: "I know it instinctively. That during a race, you can bring out power beyond your normal limits."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Sharing... Yes, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
They want to see me run even faster.
I was so happy to hear everyone say that!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy that I wanted to give
every single person the biggest hug!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I want to reach top speed together with all of you!
I want to be recognized by everyone as the fastest Umamusume!"
choice_data_list: I'll earn their recognition—by becoming the fastest sprinter!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be called the fastest Umamusume,
just being fast isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A victory in a sprint GⅠ—that is what's needed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Our next race will be...
the Sprinters Stakes, right?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "The time is finally here! The ultimate showdown of the fastest umamusume, the Sprinters Stakes!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I will kick them aside like a true final boss!
With these legs that can reach peak velocity!!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, the Ibis Summer Dash results are out.
Right O-san took 1st place."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ! The lap time... It's fast.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
She said she was aiming for top speed, but...
to think she's already made it this far...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'm still...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Believe takes 1st! Two straight wins at Kokura—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Having emerged from a long, long tunnel,
the Goddess of Victory has finally smiled upon her!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Don't rush.
Comparing yourself to others is meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm still practically just an apprentice...
All I can do is build myself up, step by step.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I will perfect my fastest running style.
And then, someday, I will definitely run in a GⅠ—!
